post.summary: Publish one immutable Agent runtime template
post.description: Requires a currently authorized service publisher. The tenant comes from the verified identity. An exact same-key replay of the effective normalized specification returns the original publication. A first publication validates current registered executor, instruction, model and tool dependencies. It does not update an active version.

parameters.name: X-Egon-Tianji-Tenant
parameters.description: Optional assertion of the verified tenant. Use exactly one decimal value. A duplicate or mismatch returns 409.

requestBody.description: Closed JSON. At most 2 MiB on the wire and 1 MiB in canonical specification form. Unknown fields, duplicate keys and trailing tokens are rejected.

minimalReasoning.summary: Publish with the default REASONING plan

200.description: First publication or same-content replay, with the original publication instant.

400.description: Malformed or oversized fields, invalid JSON shape, or invalid contract values.

explicitNullPlan.summary: A supplied null agenticPlan is invalid

401.description: A verified SERVICE credential is required.

403.description: Current resource or SERVICE scope authorization was denied.

404.description: The requested dependency or exact resource is unavailable to the authorized tenant.

409.description: The immutable key has different content, another profile occupies it, or the tenant assertion does not match.

413.description: The request exceeds the applicable input limit.

415.description: Unsupported request media type, using the existing MVC response.

429.description: Available execution or publication capacity was exceeded.

503.description: A required dependency or trusted store is unavailable.

post.summary: Submit a linked Agent runtime node
post.description: Accepts only a trusted Process service with the current source, template and execution grant. The immutable original key and digests recover an accepted run. The acknowledgement records acceptance and does not establish a terminal result.

parameters.name: X-Egon-Tianji-Tenant
parameters.description: Optional assertion of the verified tenant. Use exactly one decimal value. A duplicate or mismatch returns 409.

requestBody.description: Closed JSON. Use the original stable key, frozen hashes and absolute attempt deadline.

202.description: Durable acknowledgement of the exact linked submission.

400.description: Malformed or oversized fields, invalid JSON shape, or invalid contract values.

401.description: A verified SERVICE credential is required.

403.description: Current resource or SERVICE scope authorization was denied.

404.description: The requested dependency or exact resource is unavailable to the authorized tenant.

409.description: The original key or binding differs, the dispatch is expired or closed, or a tenant/revision check failed.

413.description: The request exceeds the applicable input limit.

415.description: Unsupported request media type, using the existing MVC response.

429.description: Available execution or publication capacity was exceeded.

503.description: A required dependency or trusted store is unavailable.

oauth2.description: Only verified service identities may call these operations.

RuntimeVersion.description: Send a plain integer JSON token. Numeric strings, fractions and exponent notation are rejected by the service.

Duration.description: A positive ISO 8601 duration. The service validates positivity and relationships between timeout values.

TypedValue.description: Typed JSON rejects floating-point tokens, invalid Unicode and NUL. Values are bounded to depth 8.

pattern.description: Portable search pattern. Allows ASCII literals and literal escapes, non-negated character classes and ranges, optional absolute anchors, and ?, {n}, or {m,n}. Maximum expanded width is 128. The service validates the complete grammar, ranges and width.

format.description: A real ISO calendar date, UTC Z instant with 0–6 fractional digits, or exact fixed-scale decimal string. The service validates and normalizes values.

ProcessSchemaVO.description: Closed typed schema, at most 32 KiB and depth 8. The service checks that required keys are declared and minimum is no greater than maximum.

TechnicalLimitsVO.description: Total timeout is bounded by the node limit. Idle and tool timeouts are bounded by total timeout. Output tokens per call cannot exceed the context window. These relationships are validated by the service.

TemplateConfigurationVO.description: Frozen host capability references. Omit agenticPlan for the single-executor route. Explicit null is rejected.

AgenticTemplateLinkVO.description: Source and target are different declared agentKey values. The service validates declarations and equality.

AgenticTemplatePlanVO.description: Defaults apply at publication. Effective maxRounds and outputAgentKey are null where the selected strategy or merge has no value. The service checks unique declared agent keys, declaration and equality of edge endpoints, declared output and shared agent references, and at most eight path segments.

AgenticConditionVO.description: At most 64 nodes and depth 8. A literal may be null. A path must be round, template input, or fixed output of a declared leaf. A missing or unavailable path does not match as a null literal.

AgentProcessLink.description: Exact trusted process occurrence. The service checks source, linked ownership and dispatch deadline.

input.description: Canonical typed object, at most 64 KiB, validated against the frozen input schema.

parameters.description: Canonical typed object, at most 64 KiB, validated against the frozen parameter schema.

attemptDeadlineAt.description: Absolute attempt deadline. It cannot exceed the node deadline or be extended by the receiver.
